rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for playing energetically, noisily, or roughly.

example.english: The kids romp around the living room.
example.traditional: 啲細路喺客廳玩得好癲。
example.jyutping: di1 sai3 lou6 hai2 haak3 teng1 waan2 dak1 hou2 din1

rows.note: Use this when someone wins a contest or competition with little difficulty.

example.english: We romp to an easy win in yesterday’s final.
example.traditional: 我哋尋日場決賽輕鬆咁贏。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 cam4 jat6 coeng4 kyut3 coi3 hing1 sung1 gam3 jeng4

rows.note: Use this when someone gets through an exam, stage, or other challenge easily rather than specifically defeating an opponent.

example.traditional: 我哋今次考試輕鬆過關。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 hing1 sung1 gwo3 gwaan1
